$comment: Frictionless Table Schema v1. One file per test; rows from all cells.
name: spend_delivery
title: Spend and delivery by cell, geo and day
description: Used by Read for iCPA/iROAS and the geo-leakage check.

fields.name: cell
fields.description: Must equal a cell label or cell id in the locked plan.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.description: Geo where impressions were delivered, in the plan's geo unit. Use * for spend or impressions the vendor cannot attribute to a geo.

fields.name: spend
fields.description: Media cost in the plan currency. May be 0 on geo rows if the vendor reports spend only on a * row.
